verdict.rationale: Working Copy documents SSH as a supported protocol for git remotes. Private keys can be imported or generated and attached to an Identity, and can optionally live on the Secure Enclave. However, this SSH support only covers git transport; nothing shows general remote-server connections or terminal sessions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of which key types are supported (Ed25519, ECDSA, RSA), evidence of general SSH connections to remote servers beyond git remotes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
